ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S5.1 Hybrid Tail Rescue is based on S4/S1 for RimWorld 1.5. ThingRequest behavior remains unchanged. For custom search sets whose Count is available without enumeration, Count 1-127 may use validator-first/live-CanReach acceleration after the current JobPackage reaches 24ms, while Count 128+ remains Vanilla after the S4 32ms rescue point. Unknown/lazy custom enumerables retain S4 behavior. S5.1 uses the normal RimMT Harmony owner so CompatibilityGuard does not misclassify its own routing layer as a foreign patch. JR1/JR1.1, S2 fanout and S3 learned admission remain retired.
